nice! I was thinking, in order to help enforce correctness and prevent stale configs, we should persist versions as well, maybe something like:

```
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_configs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    "organization_id" uuid not null,
    -- the API key used by a gateway instance to authenticate itself to Helicone
    "gateway_key_id" bigint,
    -- optional but in case we want human readable names
    name VARCHAR(255),
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_config_versions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    config_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES gateway_configs(id),
    -- some hash
    version VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    config JSONB NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
```
